newsitem.title: USA: GOLF-ELS SCORES HOLE IN ONE AT PGA CHAMPIONSIP.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-ELS SCORES HOLE IN ONE AT PGA CHAMPIONSIP.

text.p: Ernie Els, who has struggled in the PGA Championship, finally figured out how to conquer Winged Foot Golf Club's notorious greens -- hole your tee shot.
The 27-year-old South African, who won his second U.S. Open in June, aced Winged Foot's "signature" hole, the 190-yard 10th, on Sunday morning for the first hole in one of the championship.
Els, who also won the 1994 U.S. Open, used a 6-iron to ace the picturesque hole, which course architect A.W. Tillinghast called his favorite par-3.

Els's eagle, the 17th of the championship, still left him at eight over par -- well behind co-leaders Davis Love and Justin Leonard, who were at seven under par. They were not due to tee off until early afternoon.
